{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First few revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Display unique revenue values to check format
print(f"\nUnique revenue values (first 10):\n{df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")"}
